title: Physarum growth no-division negative replicates on fresh seeds 2 and 3: with agent turnover 0 splits and 5 merges per seed, 7-8 persistent bounded clusters drifting 2.8-3.1 body lengths; without turnover 0 splits and 0 merges
summary: Ran the finding's world.py on fresh seeds 2 and 3 with the settings its summary gives (SA 120, RA 45; turnover: 1% initial density, birth at <= 10 agents in the 9x9 window, removal above 25; no-turnover arm: 5% density, pb = pd = 0), 128^2, 5000 steps, spf 25. With turnover: 0 splits, 5 and 5 merges, 7 and 8 persistent clusters, max/min area 4.6 and 3.7, max 3.1 and 2.8 body lengths. Without turnover: 0 splits, 0 merges, 5 and 5 persistent clusters, max 2.8 and 1.8 body lengths. growth/seed2/sheet.png: about 8 clusters form from the sparse start by t=200, drift, and merge down to 6 by t=5000, with none splitting.

observations.finding: summary_seeds23.txt: turnover 0 splits / 5 merges on both seeds, no turnover 0 / 0; growth/seed2/sheet.png clusters merge 8 -> 6 and never split

seeds_run.result: pass (negative reproduced): 0 splits, 5 merges, 7 persistent clusters
pass (negative reproduced): 0 splits, 5 merges, 8 persistent clusters

verdicts.limitation: dmax 25 was taken from the finding's summary (world.py's default is 40); the dmax 40/60 and SA 90 screens were not repeated. Two seeds.
